title: OrderCancelled v1
description: The `message` body of the MassTransit envelope published on the order-cancelled exchange. The order is final (specs 002, 003, 006).

reason.description: Why the order was cancelled. A new reason is an additive change (spec 006, Q3): consumers must treat a reason they do not know generically.

detail.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. which items were short.
